title: She Forgave Herself Instantly — Part 6
youtube_tags: the 100 girlfriends who really love you

series.summary: Episode 8: a genius chemist's love drug floods the school, Rentarou has to survive a campus of drugged girls, and the girl who caused it just wants to be noticed.

segments.voiceover_text: Morning, and the corridor is gold again. Beside him stands the same tiny chemist, cheeks red, eyes shut, already forgiven. He never got an apology worth the damage she caused. He made room for her in his life anyway, because that is simply who he is.

So she does the only thing she knows how to do. She grins, lifts two fresh beakers, and starts brewing all over again. Loving this boy was never going to be safe. Part of him already knew that, and he stayed anyway.
